revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue mainly from reselling third-party products such as ceiling fans, heaters and light fixtures, paired with its plug and play feature, and expects sales from direct sales and licensing of advanced and smart products.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially most of our revenues come from the resale of third-party products, which include ceiling fans, heaters, light fixtures, paired, to the extent possible, with our standard "plug and play" feature either built in or with an adaptive kit.

changes.text: In 2023 the company expanded operations by acquiring Belami, an online retailer and e-commerce provider specializing in home lighting, ceiling fans, and other home furnishings.
changes.evidence: On April 28, 2023, we completed our acquisition (the "Closing") of all of the issued and outstanding shares of Belami, an online retailer and e-commerce provider specializing in home lighting, ceiling fans, and other home furnishings.

changes.text: The company wound down sales of its standard products by discontinuing production of light fixtures and ceiling fans with the older Sky Plug & Receptacle in favor of a new product line.
changes.evidence: We wound down the sales of our standard products by discontinuing production of light fixtures and ceiling fans that include the older version of our standard Sky Plug & Receptacle in favor of launching our new line of products described below.
